mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trx_expense_request (department_code, emp_id, emp_name, request_date, regular_transport_amount, nonregular_transport_amount, other_expense_amount, total_amount, approval_status, public_flg, edit_flg, remarks, create_user_id, update_user_id, create_time, update_time, del_flg) VALUES (#{departmentCode}, #{empId}, #{empName}, #{requestDate}, #{regularTransportAmount}, #{nonregularTransportAmount}, #{otherExpenseAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{approvalStatus}, #{publicFlg}, #{editFlg}, #{remarks}, #{createUserId}, #{updateUserId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{delFlg})
mapper.update: UPDATE trx_expense_request SET department_code = #{departmentCode}, emp_id = #{empId}, emp_name = #{empName}, request_date = #{requestDate}, regular_transport_amount = #{regularTransportAmount}, nonregular_transport_amount = #{nonregularTransportAmount}, other_expense_amount = #{otherExpenseAmount}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, approval_status = #{approvalStatus}, public_flg = #{publicFlg}, edit_flg = #{editFlg}, remarks = #{remarks}, update_user_id = #{updateUserId}, update_time = #{updateTime}, del_flg = #{delFlg} WHERE id = #{id}
